summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of its acquisition from Vista Energy of a 16.3% stake in Bandurria Sur Participaciones S.A. (holding a 30% interest in the Bandurria Sur area) and a 15% stake in the Bajo del Toro and Bajo del Toro Norte areas, increasing YPF's total direct and indirect interests to 44.9% and 65%, respectively. The total price was approximately US$163 million plus a closing adjustment and contingent consideration totaling about US$41 million. YPF operates all areas. The transaction closed on May 7, 2026, as previously announced on February 2, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. The deal involves non-conventional hydrocarbon assets in Vaca Muerta. Watch for integration updates and contingent consideration payouts.
